default.title: Submit Inquiry
default.text: Share your item type, quantity, size, material, event date, and design concept via form or email.

default.title: Receive Quotation
default.text: Your detailed quote arrives within 24–48 hours. Bulk orders qualify for exclusive pricing.

default.title: Design Approval
default.text: We send a digital mockup. Revisions continue until every detail is exactly right.

default.title: Confirm & Pay
default.text: Once the layout is approved, we’ll require a down payment to start production.

default.title: Production
default.text: Standard production time: 5-10 working days (may vary depending on quantity and complexity).

default.title: Pick-up or Delivery
default.text: You may pick up your order from our location. Or, we can arrange shipping via courier or delivery service (fees apply).
